meta.name: cirq
meta.description: Google quantum computing framework. Use when targeting Google Quantum AI hardware, designing noise-aware circuits, or running quantum characterization experiments. Best for Google hardware, noise modeling, and low-level circuit design. For IBM hardware use qiskit; for quantum ML with autodiff use pennylane; for physics simulations use qutip.

copy.tagline: 设计并运行量子电路，模拟噪声并部署到谷歌量子硬件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用谷歌量子硬件做低层电路开发或量子表征实验
copy.tagline_en: Design and run quantum circuits, simulate noise, and deploy to Google quantum hardware
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are developing low-level quantum circuits for Google hardware or running characterization experiments

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以用 Python 代码设计、模拟和运行量子电路，支持参数扫描、噪声建模和硬件执行。
howto.when: 当你需要构建或模拟量子电路、在 Google 量子处理器上运行任务、或进行噪声建模与量子表征实验时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Cirq 创建一个 Bell 态电路并模拟 1000 次。
say.note: Claude 会生成并运行示例电路。

say.text: 用 Cirq 对参数 theta 从 0 到 2π 做 20 点扫描。
say.note: Claude 会构建参数化电路并执行扫描。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can design, simulate, and run quantum circuits in Python, supporting parameter sweeps, noise modeling, and hardware execution.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to build or simulate quantum circuits, run jobs on Google quantum processors, or perform noise modeling and characterization experiments.

say_en.text: Create a Bell state circuit with Cirq and simulate 1000 shots.
say_en.note: Claude will generate and run the example circuit.

say_en.text: Sweep parameter theta from 0 to 2π with 20 points using Cirq.
say_en.note: Claude will build a parameterized circuit and run the sweep.
